label: independent DiffusionOT-like reimplementation; not an exact reproduction of the published mouse experiment

row_policy.cells: retain all source rows in canonical order; no cell filtering because the published rare-type threshold and exact 43,968-row selection are unavailable

expression_preprocessing.input_matrix: Klein Lab normed_counts as distributed; verify cell x gene orientation against metadata and gene names
expression_preprocessing.gene_detection_filter: retain genes nonzero in at least ceil(0.01 * n_cells) cells
expression_preprocessing.transform: log1p on the distributed normalized expression values
expression_preprocessing.feature_selection: Scanpy highly_variable_genes(flavor='seurat', n_top_genes=3000, batch_key=None, subset=False), then preserve returned source gene order
expression_preprocessing.cell_type_filter: none; retain all source annotations because the published cutoff is unspecified
expression_preprocessing.scaling_after_log1p: none; published notebook's NPZ-writing cell has no explicit scaling call

important_deviations_from_published_run: Exact published cell subset and cell-type exclusion threshold are unavailable; retain all 130887 source cells.
Exact HVG algorithm and feature order are unavailable; use Scanpy 1.11.2 flavor='seurat' and preserve its selected features in source order.
The public notebook does not show a scaler in its NPZ-writing cell; no separate scaler is applied.
This arm is reported separately from the frozen published-checkpoint arm and must not be called an exact reproduction.
